field.label: Enable
field.help: Keep the "Home networks" list of Intrusion Detection up to date with the addresses your provider gives this firewall. Your own entries in that list are never changed. Turning this off stops further updates, the entries that were already added stay in the list until you remove them.

field.label: Interface
field.help: The interface that receives the delegated IPv6 prefix (DHCPv6 prefix delegation) and, if enabled below, the IPv4 address to follow. Usually WAN.

field.label: Also follow the IPv4 address
field.help: Also keep the current IPv4 address of this interface (a single address) in the Home networks list, and replace it when your provider changes it. Useful when your provider gives the WAN a private address (for example 10.x.x.x or 100.64.x.x) that is not covered by your Home networks, so that traffic to and from the firewall's own address is still recognised as yours. Leave it off if your Home networks already cover that address. The IPv6 prefix is always followed.
